claim: The Oriole userspace can distinguish a registered 4G/5G modem with an attached data bearer from a modem that is merely enumerated.
oracle: A read-only probe reports registration state, access technology and a connected bearer without printing identifiers or creating an APN/bearer.

user_journey.scenario: The user inserts the China Mobile SIM, boots Omarchy and checks mobile data before launching an Agent.
user_journey.expected: The user sees registered plus LTE/5G access and a connected bearer, or receives a specific registration/bearer failure while Wi-Fi/USB recovery remains available.

invariants: The probe only invokes ModemManager read operations.
It never sends connect, disconnect, reset or APN commands.
IMEI, SIM identifiers, bearer addresses and APN values are never printed.
gitnexus: The package install boundary stages the probe; no boot, flash, modem-power or partition path imports it.
ast: Registration and bearer state are separate booleans; a control node alone cannot pass.

unit.red: The public tree had only cdc-wdm presence and no registration/bearer readout.
unit.green: Fixtures cover LTE registration plus connected bearer, searching registration, no modem and identifier redaction.
cases: registered modem with no connected bearer

boundaries: cellular bearer -> default route -> Agent HTTPS probe
evidence: Offline fixture passes; live China Mobile registration and 4G/5G traffic remain pending.

limitations: This probe cannot provide the CPIF kernel driver, firmware or carrier APN.
A live LTE/5G status still needs an attended phone run and an independent HTTPS request.
exit_gate: Run the probe on a cold Omarchy boot with the SIM inserted, then run the Agent network probe while Wi-Fi is disabled and record the access technology and HTTPS result.
